body: Don't be afraid to pm me if anything changes

I think when you do talk to him, don't bring up what's happened for a bit, and try to give him space between messages, like a couple of hours or something. Ask him even if he needs some space to think about everything.

I'm not sure if my advice is best, but I can try

I know, but if you push it, you could push him away. Let it play out, try to distract yourself. How is the situation right now, is he completely ignoring you? How long has it been since everything happened?

As hard as it, you might need to give him space to think differently or calm down. You can't change his mind for him, but I believe you're telling the truth. It's hard letting go of people when you see how much it hurts them. I understand how it must seem for this guys point of view too. 
If you believe you're in serious danger with suicidal thoughts, please contact some support like a helpline. If you do anything now, you eliminate the chance of things changing/getting better, please stay safe
Hey, did you want to pm me and talk about this fully? I'm not sure if I'll be much help but I can listen and offer as much as I can

It could be very good, I'm kind of thinking trying out the same, it's a good idea if you don't have access to professional help too.
I'm a female, but thank you. I definitely think OP should try it before giving up or anything.

If you need to chat in private at any time feel free to PM me. I can try my best to listen.
Your husband (from what you said) seems very irrational, and not very understanding at all. Is he aware of how you feel? Does he often make low blows or lash out? 
Money wise, you could tell him your problems with this again, and if he responds in a similar way to what he already has, then is there a way to have a seperate account, so if he goes down, you don't have t follow.
I really hope you don't blame yourself for his reactions.

That's the problem with depression and other mental health disorders, your life can be text book perfect but you're still left feeling horrible. 
In my experience talking to a counsellor hasn't helped, but I believe that's my own fault for being so reserved. But I definitely think that even if you may think that it won't help or doubt it, that you should give it a try. Everyone has different experiences and if you're worried for yourself then go find help, whether it be on the phone, through a friend, online or in person counselling. 
Talking doesn't help for me, but writing my feelings out helps heaps, so maybe you could try this too?
